critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/health uses SELECT 1 via engine.connect() — good. Consider caching a healthy result for 1-2s under load so a burst of health probes doesn't hammer the pool; currently every probe opens a fresh connection.

The launcher script /app/.emergent/postgres_launcher.sh runs `alembic upgrade head` on every boot. If a migration is mid-edit or fails, PG will loop-restart under supervisor. Consider gating alembic behind a lockfile or a boot flag to avoid tight-loop restarts on migration errors.

mart products seed shortfall (60 vs target 100+) suggests seed idempotency guard may be short-circuiting when a partial seed already exists. Verify /app/backend/modules/mart/seed.py checks per-category product counts, not just presence of any product row.

/api/admin/modules/express/stats returns hardcoded drivers_available string '30/30' — brittle. Should compute from module_drivers table (active/total) so it changes when drivers are onboarded/deactivated.

Serviceability endpoint returns country:'CI' echo for any lat/lng — no cross-check between coordinates and country boundary. A CI-country request with LR coordinates would still respond serviceable:false but with country:'CI' — arguably fine, but flag if later features (billing zones) rely on lat/lng-derived country.

rca of the issue: PRIOR outage RCA (already fixed by main agent, verified here): container restart terminated Postgres process. Old /api/health only returned {status:'ok'} without touching the DB, so the ingress+frontend probes passed and the outage was silent — UI just rendered empty because every SELECT was 5xxing under-the-hood. FIX (verified live): (a) /api/health now runs SELECT 1 via engine.connect() and returns 503 {status:'degraded', db:'down'} if the connect throws — no more silent DB death, (b) /etc/supervisor/conf.d/postgres.conf + /app/.emergent/postgres_launcher.sh put Postgres under supervisor with an idempotent bootstrap (baked role + db + alembic upgrade head) so container restarts self-heal, (c) /var/lib/postgresql is preserved between runs so no data loss. Post-fix state confirmed: /api/health = 200 db:'up'; all seed endpoints return data; /api/addresses/serviceability returns serviceable:true for valid Abidjan coordinates → no more 'Unable to check delivery zone' toast on the frontend.
